correctness.rationale: A complete graph-independent pair-locking proof gives the time-three cutoff for every petal count. Exact finite six-type enumeration verifies the sharp exceptional boundary m<=4; three explicit m=5,6,7 witnesses and equal-color petal padding prove sharpness for every m>=5. The exact multinomial census follows from fixed-state local constraints, the 5-ary constant term from a=b, and an exponential Hoeffding bound handles the remaining terms. An independent concentration argument proves the random first-entry law. The actual standalone program was replayed successfully and contains independent direct-labelled and compressed implementations; finite tests are not used as infinite-size proof.
